rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Dream Time (hybrid tea, Bees, 1977)
rows.Origin: Bred by Bees Ltd / Sealand Nurseries (United Kingdom, 1977).
rows.Bloom: Pink. Strong fragrance. 38 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage:
Perfecta (hybrid tea, Kordes, 1957) ×
Prima Ballerina ® (hybrid tea, Tantau, 1957)
